brief: Four final fantasy anime quest emblems for Éter Anima, matching the approved navy, antique gold, crystal and engraved book UI. Native transparent RGBA, four isolated icons in an equal 2×2 grid, no letters or raster text. Tutorial: open book and blue guiding star. Short: sealed letter and silver quill. Medium: violet astrolabe. Long: gold crystal, quill, open book and laurel. High detail, readable silhouettes, no neighboring overlap, complete ornament silhouettes.
rejection: 44 visible pixels reached a source-cell edge; tutorial ornament invaded the center gutter.
repairBrief: Preserve the four existing emblem designs and their quality. Add approximately 15 percent clear safety margin within each equal cell and a fully transparent central gutter. Show each ornament whole without clipping. Maintain native transparency, no text, no redesign or scaling performed afterward by code.
export: export-native.mjs performs only measured native crops. manifest.json records source hashes, cell bounds, border visibility and exact RGBA preservation.
